name: Glassnode
summary: A mixed light/dark institutional research-console style with cloud gray canvas, white cards, obsidian dark bands, Inter UI text, 2px geometry, hairline borders, and chart-native imagery.

pureBlack.role: Text, icons, strong contrast, filled light-surface actions

obsidian.role: Dark bands, footer, announcement bar, dark surfaces

iron.role: Muted body copy and helper text

fog.role: Muted text, icon strokes, subtle dark-band copy

cloud.role: Page canvas and spaces between bands

paper.role: Light section backgrounds and subtle inset panels

white.role: Cards, inputs, elevated surfaces, text on dark

glacierTint.role: Soft accent wash, selected states, chart fill

components.primaryFilledButton: Black or obsidian filled, white text, Inter 16px weight 500, 2px radius.
components.ghostOutlineButton: Transparent or white background with black text, 1px border, 2px radius.
components.heroChartWidget: White data widget with mist border, 2px radius, layered shadow, tabs, line chart, and search input.
components.partnerReportCard: White report card with mist border, 2px radius, cover image, uppercase label, title, and muted description.
components.darkFeatureBlock: Obsidian two-column feature block with white heading, fog body copy, and chart illustration.
components.topNavigation: White 64px nav with bottom mist border, Inter nav links, ghost CTA, and filled dark CTA.
components.subscribeForm: Dark band with white input and inverse white submit button.

dos: Use black or obsidian for primary actions rather than chromatic color.
Reserve the display face for the 56px hero H1.
Use glacier tint only as a soft wash or chart fill.
donts: Do not introduce saturated brand colors.
Do not stack colored shadows or glows.
Do not use Fraktion below the hero H1.
Do not place white cards on white backgrounds without borders.
Do not break the 8px spacing scale.
Do not use photography as product UI texture.
